threads.body:
`Assistant` always runs its Memory sub-agent: `_prepend_knowledge_prompt` calls `self.mem.run` whenever no knowledge string is passed. So this run carries a second agent span too, as the README row for qwen-agent says.

```suggestion
No tools, so the run is the agent and the model call it makes. That is what
makes the agent span readable on its own. `Assistant` still runs its Memory
sub-agent, so a second agent span comes with it.
```
